'''Anjen''' was [[Warder]] to [[Leane Sharif]]. 

==History==
He was Bonded in {{ne|977}}, a year after Leane was raised to the shawl. He died in {{ne|984}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Anjen}}

Leane was so traumatized by his death that she never bonded another Warder. She cried every night for a month and it was fully a year before the hurting stopped.{{ref/book|6|30}}
